scores.evidence: No HTML sinks, escaped print output, stale-safe paged hook; but no error boundaries and 55 eslint errors.
scores.rationale: Solid patterns where read, but missing error.jsx, red lint baseline, payment-finalisation gap and no global 401 handling.
scores.gaps: Only ~15 of 283 components read in depth; per-effect races not enumerated.

scores.evidence: Code-based only: skeleton loaders in redesigned areas, but Modal/Dropdown lack a11y and loaders/pagination are inconsistent.
scores.rationale: Visual consistency partially improved by redesign; accessibility basics missing. No visual testing was done.
scores.gaps: No browser testing; contrast, touch targets and phone-width tables not assessed.

scores.evidence: Demo credentials shown in production login, no 401 handling, app source untracked in git; SecureStore and idempotent-only retry are good.
scores.rationale: Core architecture is sound, but release-blocking hygiene issues and no tests.
scores.gaps: No device run, no dependency audit, eas.json and secret files not read, per-endpoint backend auth not verified.

findings.title: Online-payment finalisation depends only on browser callback; no Razorpay webhook
findings.impact: Captured payments can remain unrecorded if verify call fails; parent may pay twice
findings.recommendation: Add signature-verified idempotent webhook; recovery message on verify failure

findings.title: No error.jsx or global-error.jsx in app tree
findings.evidence: find app -name error.jsx returns none; only app/not-found.jsx
findings.impact: Server render errors show generic Next error page with no retry
findings.recommendation: Add error.jsx for dashboard, parent, super-admin and global-error.jsx

findings.title: ESLint: 55 errors incl. 47 set-state-in-effect
findings.evidence: npx eslint components app output; e.g. components/fees/CollectFeeModal.jsx:44
findings.impact: Extra renders, possible flicker, red lint baseline with no CI
findings.recommendation: Key-remount modal forms; fix purity errors

findings.title: No global 401/expired-session handling in client fetch layer
findings.evidence: lib/api.js:1-50 generic !res.ok throw; no 401 branch in client code
findings.impact: Expired sessions show generic failures instead of login redirect
findings.recommendation: Shared apiFetch wrapper redirecting on 401

findings.title: Modal lacks dialog semantics, focus trap, accessible close; backdrop discards forms
findings.impact: Keyboard/screen-reader users blocked; accidental data loss
findings.recommendation: role=dialog, aria-modal, labelled close, focus management, optional no-backdrop-dismiss

findings.title: Dropdown/DropdownMenu without keyboard or ARIA support
findings.evidence: no onKeyDown/aria in either; 2 aria-label total in UI
findings.impact: Core filters unusable by keyboard/AT
findings.recommendation: Add key handling and ARIA or use native select

findings.title: Mixed loaders: PageLoader spinner vs shimmer skeletons
findings.evidence: app/dashboard/loading.jsx, fees/loading.jsx, attendance/loading.jsx and 8 others import PageLoader
findings.impact: Inconsistent loading experience
findings.recommendation: Convert to skeletons progressively

findings.title: Unsaved-changes guard only in timetable editor
findings.impact: Lost edits on navigation/refresh
findings.recommendation: useBeforeUnload(isDirty) hook

findings.title: Inconsistent pagination pattern (fixed bar copies vs inline)
findings.evidence: FixedPaginationBar.jsx:16; copies at ExamDetailsClient.jsx:232, StaffAttendanceBoard.jsx:388, MarksEntrySheet.jsx:479
findings.impact: Visual inconsistency, possible overlap on small screens
findings.recommendation: Single shared bar

findings.title: Duplicate uncached server fetch in generateMetadata and page
findings.impact: Doubled DB query per navigation
findings.recommendation: Wrap getters in React cache()

findings.title: Possible double fetch on filter change; heavy router.refresh use
findings.impact: Extra server load per filter change
findings.recommendation: Single data source per explorer

findings.title: No request cancellation (AbortController in 0 files)
findings.evidence: grep AbortController components app lib returns none
findings.impact: Wasted requests, possible stale overwrites
findings.recommendation: Optional signal in api helpers

findings.title: Notification link passed to router.push unvalidated
findings.impact: None demonstrated; links are server-generated internal paths
findings.recommendation: Require leading single slash

findings.title: Very large components
findings.impact: Review difficulty; effect-state issues
findings.recommendation: Split when touched

findings.title: Demo credentials hard-coded and displayed in production login
findings.impact: Release builds expose seeded account credentials; access if accounts exist in production
findings.recommendation: Gate with __DEV__, delete/rotate seeded accounts in production

findings.title: Real mobile app not under version control; config files untracked
findings.evidence: git log shows 1 commit, no remote; src/App.js, features, eas.json, google-services.json untracked
findings.impact: No backup/history; accidental staging of config files
findings.recommendation: Commit app, add private remote, keep adminsdk key and keystore out

findings.title: No 401 handling; logout does not reset RTK Query cache
findings.evidence: baseApi.js:6-37 no 401 branch; ProfileScreen.js:62-70 no resetApiState; JWT 7d (jwt.js:10)
findings.impact: Stuck session on expiry; possible stale data across users
findings.recommendation: 401 -> clear and logout; resetApiState on logout

findings.title: Push token never unregistered on logout
findings.evidence: only register-token route exists; pushTokens.js:8-9 upsert by token
findings.impact: Previous user's notifications keep arriving after logout
findings.recommendation: Add unregister endpoint and call on logout

findings.title: Razorpay verify failure shown as Payment failed after capture
findings.impact: User may pay twice; fee unrecorded
findings.recommendation: Separate verify failure message, refetch fees, add webhook

findings.title: Silent localhost API fallback; login error reveals API URL
findings.impact: Misconfigured release build fails silently; dev text shown to users
findings.recommendation: Fail loudly if unset outside __DEV__

findings.title: No tests despite jest setup
findings.impact: No regression protection for auth/payment
findings.recommendation: Add tests for baseQuery and fee helpers

findings.title: No accessibility labels in mobile UI
findings.impact: Screen reader users blocked
findings.recommendation: Label shared Button and icon buttons first

findings.title: Offline handling is banner-only; no draft/write queue
findings.impact: Teachers lose entries on poor network
findings.recommendation: Keep drafts until save succeeds

findings.title: Client-side role selection; backend enforces from JWT (informational)
findings.evidence: role from AsyncStorage drives tabs; server derives role from signed JWT
findings.impact: No defect; per-endpoint auth not verified here
findings.recommendation: Keep authorization server-side

findings.title: Generated manifest requests RECORD_AUDIO and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
findings.evidence: manifest lines 4-5; app.json declares neither; android/ is git-ignored
findings.impact: Over-broad permissions if present in release
findings.recommendation: blockedPermissions in app.json; inspect release manifest

findings.title: Very large mobile screen files
findings.impact: Hard to test and review
findings.recommendation: Split when touched

notAssessed: Per-effect race analysis of 47 flagged effects — time-bounded
Mobile dependency vulnerabilities and build — npm audit/builds not run
Mobile eas.json profile and secret separation — file not read per rules
Per-endpoint backend authorization for mobile routes — belongs to backend auditors
